notes: Model weights are NOT bundled (licensing + size). The app tries the local `path` first (same-host, private, fast) and falls back to `remote`/`remotes` when present — so the SAME build works for local dev (files next to this manifest) and for static hosts like GitHub Pages (no weights in the repo). Remote hosts only ever see a file download, never user pixels. `remote` files were hash-verified against the reference copies (see MODELS.md). Mirror URLs must serve real bytes with CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`): use direct media/raw file URLs, never HTML/redirect/LFS-pointer pages.

input.name: input.1
input.layout: NCHW float32; verified fixed [1,3,640,640] on the mirrored export, dynamic exports also accepted (app always feeds a 640x640 letterbox)

detector.postprocessing: anchor grid per stride [8,16,32] x2 anchors, distance2bbox/kps, threshold, NMS IoU 0.4 (+1px convention), /det_scale
detector.license: InsightFace model license (non-commercial research unless arranged; code is MIT). See MODELS.md.

recognizer.license: InsightFace model license (contact recognition-oss-pack@insightface.ai for licensing). See MODELS.md.

swapper.license: AGPL-3.0 (somanchiu/ReSwapper, code + weights). Copyleft: weights installed separately by the operator, never bundled; preserve license notices. See MODELS.md.
swapper.provenance: Author disclosure: training used inswapper outputs among its targets. Verified contract-identical to inswapper_128 (inputs target/source, output, 512x512 emap initializer, opset 11). E2E identity transfer measured 0.58-0.87 ArcFace cosine (tools/verify-swap.mjs).
swapper.backend: WebGPU strongly recommended; WASM works but is slow

emap.role: Last-initializer projection (512x512 row-major) extracted once from YOUR reswapper copy.

swapper_inswapper.license: InsightFace model license: non-commercial research unless arranged (contact@insightface.ai). Install YOUR licensed copy as public/models/inswapper_128.onnx, then extract the emap sidecar (same tool works).
swapper_inswapper.backend: WebGPU strongly recommended; WASM works but is slow

emap_inswapper.role: Last-initializer projection (512x512 row-major) extracted once from YOUR licensed inswapper_128 copy.

swapper_reswapper256.role: Identity-conditioned face swap, 256x256 (ReSwapper 256, inswapper-compatible contract at 256).
swapper_reswapper256.license: AGPL-3.0 (somanchiu/ReSwapper, code + weights). Copyleft: weights installed separately by the operator, never bundled; preserve license notices. See MODELS.md.
swapper_reswapper256.provenance: Author-released ONNX (originalInswapperClassCompatible, step 1567500). Contract verified 2026-09-08: inputs target [1,3,256,256] + source [1,512]; output symbolic [1,3,256,256]; 65 initializers, last float32 [512,512].
swapper_reswapper256.backend: WebGPU strongly recommended; WASM works but is slow

emap_reswapper256.role: Last-initializer projection (512x512 row-major) extracted once from YOUR reswapper_256 copy.
